name: 48386 · White Lake, MI
findings: ZIP 48386 (White Lake) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48386 (White Lake) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48386 (White Lake) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
